title: It's in the dumpster now
text:
It's in the dumpster now. Wish I hadn't thrown away the box to send it back in. The unit worked fine on the first day. It did a wonderful job. On the second day, the low setting wouldn't work. I set in on high, and after three hours a buzzing sound began which was followed by a loud POP. That was it. The unit was dead. Tried a different outlet but no luck.

Oh well, live and learn.

product_metadata.title: COSTWAY Infrared Heater, 600W/1200W Portable Radiant Tower Space Heater, Overheat and Tip-Over Protection, Fast and Quiet Heating, Automatic Thermostat, Electric Heater for bedroom, Indoor use
features: 🏆 Compact and Portable Infrared Heater-----Cold winter has come, and its compact size allows you to put the quartz radiant heater next to desk to warm your hands and feet whether in office or home. Meanwhile, the built-in handle and lightweight design make the quartz heater convenient to carry, so that you can get portable warmth whenever and wherever you go.

🏆 Fast and Safety Heating-----Our tower infrared heater for indoor uses high quality quartz heating element and radiation wave heating method, which is more uniform and faster than traditional quartz heater. And the quartz heater will never produce odors, chemicals, or fumes, and doesn’t stir up dust so that you feel warm and comfortable in the winter room.

🏆 Energy Saving & Adjustable Power-----Our electric quartz heater has a knob at the top to regulate the heating power and it works by heating objects rather than the whole room. So you don't have to worry about the high electricity bill. You can choose 600 watts and 1200 watts as needed to enjoy a warm winter.

🏆 Quiet and Automatic Thermostat-----Our Portable quartz heater will be based on its thermostat settings and indoor temperature automatic cycle switch to maintain temperature consistency. The low noise function allows this quartz heater to increase your comfort while maintaining the required temperature so that it won't disturb your sleep, reading and work.

🏆 Overheat & Tip-over Protection-----Enjoying with overheating protection and overturning protection devices, this quartz radiant heater will help you solve the problems of forgetting turn off the heating before leaving home or pets overturn it. When the internal components overheat or the heater overturns, this quartz heater will automatically shut down to prevent fire.
